F015 is complete and verified. The implementation was already present in the working tree from prior iterations — `model_catalog.py` (per-harness `list_models()` discovery with `ollama list`, an OpenRouter API 24h offline-safe cache, and documented pass-through for claude/codex), `models_cli.py` (`dontpanic models list --harness <id>` / `models aliases`, routed in `cli.py`), `model_aliases` merged global→project in config, and `check_model_catalog` in `dontpanic_doctor.py` distinguishing unknown model (WARN) from harness-probe rejection (FAIL). Both prior codex auditor rounds signed off; the single outstanding i1 advisory (the `models` command missing from top-level help) is already resolved at `cli.py:5881`, and `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` documents the command surface and alias config. I verified acceptance this iteration: the targeted suite passes 35/35 (including doctor unknown-warns/rejected-fails, alias resolution before probe, and pass-through freeform behavior), a runtime smoke shows `models list --harness claude` exits 0 as documented pass-through, `models aliases` renders the merged table, unknown harness exits 2, and `ruff check` is clean on all four F015 files. Freeform model strings require no code change — the catalog is data, never `AGENT_REGISTRY` keys (D010). No side-effect or deploy commands were run; verification commands only:

$ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m pytest scripts/don
